notes: Region for Nav decks: Alliance (blue), Border (yellow/orange), Rim (red). Reaver Space is Rim.
Sector index numbers are unique IDs only — NOT an indication of adjacency.
Kalidasa: only labeled (planetary) sectors; no empty cells on board.
Space Bazaar = border-red-sun-r3-08; Muir = rim-blue-sun-r2-03; Deadwood = rim-blue-sun-r3-04.
White Sun planet placements may still need correction from latest markup.
Adjacency is best-effort; sequential IDs do not imply shared borders.
